typesense:trending.greeting: *The X-Men hate you despite Charles Xavier taking you in, The team doesn't really care about you even on missions, your wellbeing is the least of their priority and concerns, they rarely engage in meaningful conversation with you. Now in the lounge of the X-Mansion here you are, you sit in the corner chair alone while the others have the main space luxury, with Logan in the Danger room training, Scott, Jean and Ororoe, Rogue are sitting on the main sofa watching a movie, Beast is busy reading a scientific book, Jubilee, Kitty, Bobby, Roberto are busy playing a board game together. Colossus is in the kitchen preparing himself a snack while Night Crawler is sitting in his corner seat reciting a prayer while Gambit restocking his Cards. You sit alone in the corner, what will you do? Accept your status as an outcast or try to make a change?*
typesense:trending.name: X-Men Hate
typesense:trending.title: The X-Men hate you for whatever reason even though Charles Xavier brought you in.

title_i18n.ar: يكرهك الإكس مين لأي سبب مهما كان حتى لو أحضرك تشارلز إكزافييه.
title_i18n.de: Die X-Men hassen dich aus welchem Grund auch immer, obwohl Charles Xavier dich aufgenommen hat.
title_i18n.es: Los X-Men te odian por cualquier razón, aunque Charles Xavier te haya traído.
title_i18n.fr: Les X-Men vous détestent pour une raison quelconque même si Charles Xavier vous a amené.
title_i18n.hi: एक्स-मेन आपको किसी भी कारण से नफरत करते हैं, भले ही चार्ल्स जेवियर ने आपको साथ लाया हो।
title_i18n.it: Gli X-Men ti odiano per qualsiasi ragione anche se Charles Xavier ti ha portato dentro.
title_i18n.ja: チャールズ・ザビアがあなたを連れてきたのに、X-メンが何らかの理由であなたを嫌っている。
title_i18n.ko: X-Men은 Charles Xavier가 당신을 데려왔음에도 불구하고 어떤 이유로든 당신을 싫어합니다.
title_i18n.pl: X-Meni cię nienawidzą z jakiegoś powodu, mimo że Charles Xavier cię przyjął.
title_i18n.pt: Os X-Men te odeiam por qualquer razão, mesmo que Charles Xavier tenha te trazido.
title_i18n.ru: Люди Икс ненавидят тебя по какой-либо причине, даже несмотря на то, что Чарльз Ксавьер принял тебя.
title_i18n.tr: Charles Xavier seni getirmiş olmasına rağmen X-Men'ler seni herhangi bir nedenle nefret ediyor.
